visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a light blue collared shirt, sits at a wooden restaurant table. She gestures towards three small bowls of food arranged on a red tray while speaking enthusiastically to the camera. The background consists of a dark-toned restaurant interior with a textured brick-style wall. (2) Close-up shots feature three distinct Wagyu beef dishes: one contains bright red raw meat topped with a raw egg yolk and silver flakes; another shows grilled beef over white rice topped with wasabi; the third displays raw beef slices mixed with scallops, orange roe, and caviar. (3) The woman uses dark chopsticks to break the raw egg yolk in the first bowl, mixing it thoroughly with the strips of raw beef. She then lifts a portion of the meat and rice to her mouth, showing a satisfied and expressive facial reaction while chewing. (4) She transitions to the second bowl, using a spoon to take a large bite of the cooked beef and rice. After chewing, she gives a thumbs-up to the camera, indicating her approval. (5) In a close-up, her hands are seen pouring a white, viscous liquid (yam) from a small floral-patterned ceramic bowl over the remaining beef and rice in one of the bowls. (6) She takes a final bite of the mixture with the yam, smiles broadly, and gestures with a thumbs-up again to conclude the tasting sequence.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 和牛三姐妹超可愛的 為什麼叫三姐妹. [Logo]: @sandykaka_. (2) [Subtitle]: 他是長女 次女、三女 是一道料理. (3) [Subtitle]: 長女是生牛肉 他的蛋上面是銀色的銀箔. (4) [Subtitle]: 他下面是飯 嗯 好香喔 他有加麻油 入口即化. (5) [Subtitle]: 他都是有飯的 沒有剛剛生牛肉驚艷 但還是挺好吃的 也還是蠻軟嫩的. (6) [Subtitle]: 等於是海鮮生牛肉飯 他海鮮很好吃. (7) [Subtitle]: 第一名是長女 他生蛋黃配生牛肉太好吃 整個在嘴巴就化掉了 滑進去. (8) [Subtitle]: 然后我覺得次女 對我來說就一般燒肉感覺 三女他是很特別 海鮮配生牛肉 很新鮮的搭配. (9) [Subtitle]: 剛太專注沒看到前面有一碗山藥 加了山藥就不一樣了 我個人很喜歡吃山藥. (10) [Subtitle]: 大加分! 很好吃!
